stemBlocks: The primary coil of an ideal, 100% efficient transformer is connected to a 240 V mains supply. A lamp L that is connected to the secondary coil has a voltage of 12V across it. An identical lamp and a switch S are also connected to the transformer as shown in the diagram.
With the switch open, the current in the primary coil is 0.10A. The switch is now closed.
What is the current in the primary coil now and what is the current in lamp L?
